goal: In integrations/cluster_jobs/hook.py, make a route's argument_prefixes match not only as the command's first arguments but also after leading options: every argument before the prefix must be an option (a token starting with '-') or the value directly after an option token. A positional word before the prefix still means another subcommand and must stay unrouted. Keep all existing behaviour; the acceptance test integrations/cluster_jobs/test_guard_order.py states the decision.
